Proposed diagram changes
  |-- Canvas domain model - baseline 03f2168 (before tldraw)  existing canvas
      |-- [1a] Correct: MappingPage overview
          `-- Replace the DiagramService sole-writer relationship with explicit revision retention and controller publication; keep the workspace and session ownership structure.
      |-- [1a] Correct: [D] Controller edits / agent access
          `-- Show buffered exec as the default: consecutive mutations form one controller batch, reads flush it, and compact receipts report the result. Retain immediate mode as an option.
      |-- [1b] Extend: [E] CanvasHistoryService / coordinated revisions
          `-- Add CanvasViews to the history header, pinned saved checkpoints, and publication of finished generation checkpoints; these belong to the existing history owner.
      `-- [4] Redraw: [G] DiagramService
          `-- Replace the obsolete sole-content-writer organization with pure revision operations, explicit retention, supplied-edit submission and separate generation orchestration. Preserve the distinction from canvas checkpoint publication.
  |-- AgentContext - implemented call flow and domain models (03f2168)  existing canvas
      |-- [4] Redraw: (O) Edit diagram with AgentContext - baseline 03f2168
          `-- Reorganize the single generate-then-apply flow around pinned canvas reads, optional saved or diagram-bound context, supplied edits and atomic batch installation; retain single prompt-driven edits as a supported path.
      |-- [1b] Extend: [D1] EditDiagramInput - request domain
          `-- Add required edit and replacement modes, revision-pinned references and subtree targets to the existing request preconditions.
      `-- [2] Add: Saved and diagram-owned AgentContext
          `-- Detail AgentContextLibrary records, source resolution and diagram context preparation beside scoped trajectory uploads. Connect from the overview's AgentContextService component; the immutable [D3] AgentContext snapshot remains accurate.
  |-- Mapping page - MCP and HTTP API  existing canvas
      |-- [1a] Correct: Mapping page: exposed interfaces at 03f2168
          `-- Replace exec's per-mutation default with buffered atomic execution and receipts; retain immediate mode and add canvas.read under the existing Canvas editing branch.
      |-- [1b] Extend: Mapping page: exposed interfaces at 03f2168
          `-- Add direct diagram batches, CanvasView and diagram-context tools, plus AgentChat and generation HTTP endpoints under their existing transport branches.
      |-- [1a] Correct: Mapping backend: grouped responsibilities (03f2168)
          `-- Correct the mutation contract to distinguish buffered batches from immediate commits and read-triggered flushes; proposal isolation remains unchanged.
      |-- [1b] Extend: Mapping backend: grouped responsibilities (03f2168)
          `-- Place DiagramBatchService under execution, AgentChatService and turn-bound ChatDiagramTools under chat access, and GenerationCanvasBridge under isolated canvas execution. Keep catalog publication separate.
      `-- [2] Add: Atomic diagram batch and supplied-edit path
          `-- Detail DiagramBatchService's one-snapshot validation, per-operation revision preparation, single apply-diagram-batch publication and retry status. Connect from the backend overview's DiagramBatchService component.
  |-- PersistentLayer  existing canvas
      `-- [1b] Extend: PersistentLayer
          `-- Add FileChatStore, saved AgentContext records and diagram-context storage as distinct stores; show CanvasView metadata and generated checkpoints persisting through canvas history, without changing explicit catalog publication.
  |-- ChangeSession - domain model and call tree  existing canvas
      `-- [1a] Correct: [CALLS] ChangeSession operations
          `-- Replace the claim that every exec mutation commits separately: buffered calls apply one proposal transaction, while immediate mode retains per-call commits.
  |-- Workspace persistence flow  existing canvas
      `-- [1b] Extend: Workspace persistence flow - baseline 03f2168
          `-- Include CanvasView header changes and published generation checkpoints in incremental history autosave; catalog saving remains a separate operation.
  |-- 01 - Saved CanvasViews and branching  existing canvas
      |-- [1b] Extend: Saved CanvasViews and branching
          `-- Add managed candidates under Branch from a saved checkpoint: siblings pin one saved parent endpoint and carry queued, generating and terminal status. Manual branching remains unchanged.
      `-- [2] Add: Managed generation checkpoint publication
          `-- Detail CanvasHistory.startGeneration and updateGeneration, from isolated parent checkpoint to a finished child's retained revisions and saved endpoint. Connect from the new managed-candidates component.
  |-- [3] AgentChat  new canvas
      |-- AgentChat session and turn ownership
          `-- Show AgentChatService owning Codex threads, turn events, approvals, reloadable tools and FileChatStore persistence; connect from Mapping backend: grouped responsibilities' AgentChatService component.
      `-- Turn-bound canvas tools
          `-- Show ChatCanvasBindings capturing the active canvas and access level, and ChatDiagramTools resolving selected references before direct submission. Connect from the AgentChatService overview component.
  `-- [3] Managed canvas generation  new canvas
      |-- Generation request and child lifecycle
          `-- Show AgentChatService creating independent candidate chats from a saved CanvasView and launching child turns in parallel; connect from AgentChat's generation component and Saved CanvasViews' managed-candidates component.
      `-- Isolated child canvases and settlement
          `-- Show GenerationCanvasBridge controllers, per-child persistence, cancellation, retained results and idempotent publication back to CanvasHistory.updateGeneration. Connect from the generation lifecycle component.
